data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic name Radimir, meaning 'little Radmir'. Radmir itself is composed of two elements: 'rad', meaning 'wealth', and 'mir', meaning 'peace'. Thus, Radmira represents the peaceful wealth that nurtures and protects. The name Radmira carries the meaning “Little Radmir” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Radmira usually hope their child will grow to embody little radmir and live with faith, good character and purpose.
